🇺🇸 🇷🇺 Kushner claims Russia is "satisfied" with Article 5-style security guarantees for Ukraine White House special envoy Jared Kushner, Trump's son-in-law, says the US has convinced Moscow that any security deal for Ukraine will be built on the principles of NATO's Article 5, The Guardian reports. "I know that in Russia this concept is viewed with a lot of skepticism and distrust, but that's exactly why it's important to restart dialogue between Europe and Russia," Kushner said. He added that from Washington's point of view, offering Article 5-like guarantees is a very important step and Trump is open to it, but it has to serve American interests and be part of a broader security package. Moscow has not confirmed that it agreed to anything of the kind. ℹ️ And a reminder: even NATO's real Article 5 doesn't oblige anyone to go to war. It only commits each member to take "such action as it deems necessary," which could be anything from troops to a strongly worded statement. Now imagine how much an "Article 5-style" promise would be worth. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics
